question: Does the committed record reproduce from the committed tree on a fresh execution?
n_leaves_compared: every leaf of the full record, recursively
reading: Every claim-bearing leaf of the committed record reproduces byte-identically from the committed tree on a fresh execution. The only differing leaves are wall-clock durations and a generation timestamp, which are measurements OF time and are explicitly not claimed to be deterministic. Cross-machine byte identity is still not claimed: see the recorded numeric environment in the run record.
self_check_note: An earlier build of this checker DEFINED its recursive walker and never called it, so it reported 0 differing leaves - a false clean. The call is now made and the assertion `assert differing` fails loudly if the walker ever stops running again.
